editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the DORA DevOps certification by PeopleCert. Review domains covering DevOps principles, practices, and measurement.
editorial.overview: The DORA DevOps certification exam extensively certifies your professional knowledge of DevOps capabilities, practices, and related frameworks. Administered by PeopleCert, the test evaluates important concepts across eight distinct domains, ensuring candidates understand core principles, automation mechanisms, continuous integration models, and organizational cultural frameworks required for modern software delivery across diverse enterprise environments.
editorial.who_should_take: Professionals involved in software delivery, operations, or development who want to validate their knowledge of DORA practices, continuous integration, and deployment automation. Candidates should prepare to answer 40 questions in 60 minutes.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review all eight exam domains with absolute diligence to master the core concepts. Focus your study efforts on continuous integration, deployment automation, and trunk-based development principles derived directly from the official PeopleCert materials. Practice answering sample questions under timed conditions to successfully complete the 40 questions within the allocated 60 minutes.

domain_guidance.summary: This initial domain focuses directly on exploring DevOps by introducing early concepts, history, and terminology associated with software delivery performance and organizational capabilities across diverse enterprise environments for candidates.

This specific domain covers core DevOps principles extensively, including feedback loops, working in small batches, and flow optimization across integrated development and operations teams to enhance system stability.

This particular domain examines key DevOps practices such as continuous integration, deployment automation, and trunk-based development designed to significantly improve software delivery stability and speed across engineering pipelines.

This informative domain explores vital business and technology frameworks that support organizational goals, governance models, and align technology capabilities directly with overall software delivery performance and enterprise value.

This operational domain addresses organizational culture, professional behaviours, and operating models designed to actively foster team collaboration, psychological safety, and a continuous learning environment within modern engineering teams.

This technical domain details advanced automation strategies and the architecture of DevOps toolchains designed to eliminate manual steps, reduce bottlenecks, and accelerate overall software delivery cycles efficiently across systems.

This analytical domain focuses heavily on measurement, key metrics, and reporting mechanisms used to track delivery speed, software stability, and operational performance across enterprise systems in the industry.

This final domain covers knowledge sharing, professional shadowing, and evolving practices designed to successfully scale continuous improvements and build collective organizational knowledge over time across various enterprise environments.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your time carefully during the 60 minutes. Read each question carefully, keeping track of the 40 total questions to ensure you finish within the time limit.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The official certification exam contains exactly 40 questions in total. Candidates must complete all of these multiple-choice questions within the allocated 60 minutes while successfully meeting the passing score requirement of 65%.

The official passing score required to pass the exam is 65%. Candidates must achieve this specific percentage across the 40 test questions to successfully earn the DORA DevOps certification credential.
The total exam duration is strictly set to 60 minutes. During this time window, candidates are required to answer 40 multiple-choice questions covering all eight distinct domains of the syllabus.

faq.question_title: What certifying body administers the exam?
faq.answer_text: The certification exam is officially administered by PeopleCert. For long-term certification path details, rules, and renewal requirements, check directly with PeopleCert for the current path.

methodology.summary: This detailed informational guide was built using official exam documentation and verified hard facts regarding the DORA DevOps certification program and its requirements.
